payload.headline: Big sprint — 10 ships: founder-identity leaks zeroed portfolio-wide, the Ark gained a real work-assignment lane, and three silently-drifting tool pairs were collapsed into single policy sources.
bullets: CANON-028 sweep went 211 violations → 1 (the last sits in a locked repo). The real fix: both identity scanners now share one allowlist lib instead of drifting copies — 152 of the 'violations' were the scanner flagging its own report.

The Ark can now assign work: dispatch + dispatch-ack cargo with acceptance tracking, plus session-handoff batons for cross-repo follow-ups. Four CANON-029 cost-discipline assignments are live (hashmark, mindframe, ideaforge, promogrind).
Ark v2 reliability landed: exponential-backoff retries, dead-letter queue, and a real alarm channel (email today, Sentry auto-upgrade when the token lands).
IGNIS portfolio scores went from 13 days stale to fresh across all 33 projects — and the closeout now rescores touched repos automatically (the old 'wiring' only existed in a docstring).

Every /start was failing its own brief-size validator deterministically; budget re-baselined to match deliberately-shipped surface. Repair mode can no longer overwrite real context files with templates.
353 protocol-script files propagated to ~25 repos; locked repos now auto-queue instead of being silently dropped. Seamline identity fix pushed; Ouren + SparkRaid registered.
payload.synopsis: A full /go sprint that kept finding the same disease: paired tools whose policies drifted apart. Three shared libs now hold the single source of truth for identity scanning, protocol propagation, and brief budgets. Next session opens with 9 escalated [SIL:2⛔] items and 3 failing doctor probes.
